description.narrative: IFC expects the Project to contribute to increased formal employment and value addition in the retail sector and along the supply chain, as well as to emission reductions through investments in high-efficiency bakery equipment in production facility and energy-efficient refrigeration units across retail stores. Beyond the Project, IFC investment is expected to enhance market competitiveness by supporting the growth of specialty retail chains with vertically integrated value chains and by fostering capacity-building initiatives in the retail market in Azerbaijan.

The proposed investment is an IFC financing package of up to US$10 million to AZZA CJSC (AZZA or the Company) to finance a portion of the components for a new industrial bakery plant, the largest in Azerbaijan, and the roll-out of new stores across Azerbaijan (the Project). The Project is expected to be supported by Blended Finance, as described in the Blended Finance section. AZZA is the largest baked goods manufacturer, the largest gastronomy retailer and the largest importer of European confectionary products in Azerbaijan.
